name: troupe
description: Six characters, each one neuron, each with its own line and its own hand: a cue reaches all six, every answer is sent round the ring, and maxHops 2 stops the exchange. Run it and the trace is a scene in six skins - the stage composites a mixed cast (spikes/003).

neurons.description: The line that starts the scene: whoever holds the stage says it, and the troupe hears it at once.
Ann, who prints in fluorescent pink and never registers the second colour.
Bo, who draws in screentone and speed lines and thinks colour is for children.
Cy, who owns one bottle of black ink and has opinions about the others.
Di, screen-printed in three spot inks with a burst behind her, and loud about it.
Ed, made of light: scan lines, a lit grid, no paper at all.
Fay, a soft pencil and nothing more, and the only one who is not arguing.
